utterances.text: Hello dear, how was your day?
Hi Grandma! My day was pretty good, just a bit busy with schoolwork.
Oh, nothing bad happened, just a lot of assignments to finish. But I'm managing!
I think it's in the sewing basket. Let me help you find it.
Hello there, I hope you're doing well. Do you need any help with the sewing?
Thank you for offering to help. I think we can manage, but it's nice to know you're here.
Thanks, Grandpa! I'm doing well, just busy with schoolwork. I appreciate the offer though!
Oh dear, what's wrong? Can I help with something?
Oh, nothing's wrong, Grandma. Just a bit overwhelmed with all the assignments. Thanks for asking!
I'm glad you think so! It's always nice to see your work appreciated.
Thanks, Grandma! It really means a lot to me. I'm trying my best to keep up with everything.
Ah, I see! Thank you for explaining that to me. I'm learning new things every day.
I'm glad you're learning too, Grandma! It's fun to share things with you.
Yes, it looks perfectly straight to me. You've done a wonderful job!
Thank you, Grandma! I'm really happy you think so. It makes all the effort worth it.
I'm so proud of you for paying attention to detail. It really shows in your work.
Thanks, Grandma! Your support means a lot to me.
I'm glad you're happy with it! Your hard work is paying off.
